industries.title: Toughening Plant
industries.subtitle: FORCED CONVECTION FURNACE
industries.description:
We’ve embarked on a comprehensive transformation, adopting state-of-the-art equipment — a clear testament to our unwavering commitment to uncompromising quality.

Our advanced forced-convection tempering furnaces process toughened glass designed for maximum structural safety and flawless optical performance.

industries.title: Lamination & Cleanroom
industries.subtitle: PVB & SENTRYGLAS® LAMINATING
industries.description:
Our dust-free, climate-controlled cleanroom facilities and high-pressure autoclave lines ensure flawless bonding of PVB, EVA, and SentryGlas® interlayers.

This guarantees high-impact security glass for prestigious architectural facades and high-security structural installations.

industries.title: Double Glazing (DGU)
industries.subtitle: INSULATED GLASS MANUFACTURING
industries.specs: Automatic Spacer Application & Argon Gas Filling
industries.description:
Equipped with automated DGU assembly lines, we manufacture double-glazed unit solutions offering optimal thermal insulation, soundproofing, and energy efficiency.

Designed to withstand harsh environmental conditions while reducing building HVAC energy load.

industries.title: Quality Control Center
industries.subtitle: COMPREHENSIVE QUALITY ASSURANCE
industries.description:
From raw material inception to final dispatch, every glass unit undergoes stringent multi-stage inspection.

Our commitment to quality ensures every pane delivered meets international safety and architectural standards.
